newsitem.title: USA: Aequitron sees December 5 close to Nellcor deal.
newsitem.headline: Aequitron sees December 5 close to Nellcor deal.

text.p: Aequitron Medical Inc, which reported record fiscal 1997 second quarter sales and earnings, said it expects its proposed acquisition by Nellcor Puritan Bennett Inc to close December 5, 1996.

"We are pleased with our record performance during the quarter," said Jim Hickey, Aequitron president, in a statement. "Sales were strong even though there was some uncertainty among customers which is inherent in any acquisition period," he said.

He added that a proposed acquisition of Aequitron by Nellcor Puritan Bennett is proceeding on schedule and is expected to close December 5, 1996, pending approval by Aequitron's shareholders. Agreement was reached in September.

Aequitron reported record sales for its second quarter ended October 31, 1996 of $10.6 million, up 9.4 percent from the same period last year. Net income for the second quarter was a record $758,400 or $0.14 a share, up 6.4 percent over the same period a year ago.
Aequitron designs, makes and markets electronic respiratory products for home healthcare, sub-acute care and hospital use.
